title.en: halloween ice disco at the dolder.

line.en: a halloween ice disco on the dolder rink on saturday. check the times with the rink before you go.
line.de: eine halloween-eisdisco auf der eisbahn am dolder am samstag. zeiten vorher bei der eisbahn prüfen.
line.tr: cumartesi dolder buz pistinde halloween buz diskosu. saatleri gitmeden önce pistten kontrol et.

sparks.why: Halloween ice disco at the Dolder rink, Sat 31 Oct 2026, 16:00 to 22:00; the rink reopened 17 Oct (nume.ch Halloween 2026 listing).

line.en: karaoke at the raffles bar in restaurant singapore on badenerstrasse, saturday from 22:00 to 02:00.
line.de: karaoke in der raffles bar im restaurant singapore an der badenerstrasse, samstag von 22:00 bis 02:00.
line.tr: badenerstrasse'deki restaurant singapore'un raffles bar'ında cumartesi 22:00 ile 02:00 arası karaoke.

sparks.why: The Raffles Bar in Restaurant Singapore, Badenerstrasse 530: karaoke every weekend, Fri to Sun 22:00 to 02:00, per the restaurant's listing on search.ch (https://search.ch/tel/zuerich/badenerstrasse-530/restaurant-singapore-2.en.html). Not checked against the venue's own site.
